sections.executive_summary: The quant stack has eight archived history runs and enough backtest/historical-analysis volume to compare horizons, but forward paper evidence is still the binding constraint: the primary AI-judgment track is underperforming the market after costs (excess −11.14%) while beating the rules control (−19.73%). Archived 7-day signal work shows positive raw/smoothed excess across most buckets, yet offline simulation’s research overlay underperforms benchmark (−7.88% excess over eight periods), so archived signal strength is not translating cleanly into simulated or paper P&L. Paper tracks show a clear cost-churn story—AI-judgment cost drag 16.1% vs rules 22.8% vs momentum_grace 2.9%—and a min_conviction raise (0.15→0.2) was already applied on AI-judgment, starting a fresh knob epoch with zero epoch marks. The single biggest modelling/analysis gap this week is the disconnect between thick-ish archived signal excess (run_count=8) and negative paper excess after costs, compounded by exit-shadow cohorts with zero closed exits and no realized exit-timing learning yet.
sections.performance_diagnosis:
- **Primary (ai_judgment) vs market:** excess_after_costs −11.14% vs benchmark_return +1.25%; beat_market=false; verdict=underperforming.
- **Primary vs control (rules):** primary −11.14% vs control −19.73%; beat_control=true — AI-judgment loses less after costs but both tracks are underwater vs market.
- **Momentum_grace (experimental):** excess_after_costs −2.01% (benchmark −0.90%) — best paper excess among the three compared tracks, with lowest cost drag (2.91%) and only 5 lifetime trades.
- **Cost drag:** rules 22.83% (£228.32 on £1,000 contributed); ai_judgment 16.13% (£161.34); momentum_grace 2.91% (£29.15). Churn_health flags both rules and ai_judgment as “elevated cost drag” watches; each logged 16 trades in the last 7 days (8 buys / 8 full exits).
- **Mark thickness:** ai_judgment has 10 lifetime equity_marks (epoch marks=0 post knob apply); rules 11; momentum_grace 7; technical only 2 with benchmark unavailable — epoch-level benchmark comparison on ai_judgment is not yet trustworthy (“Insufficient epoch marks for benchmark span”). Exit_shadow has 0 closed exits on all tracks — no realized exit-timing marks.
- **Counterfactual signal (not applied):** ai_judgment replay at min_conviction=0.2 estimates cost_drag could fall from 16.13% to 7.41% (−8.72 pp), but replay limitations note min_conviction/AI gates need archived weekly screens for full P&L — treat as directional only.
- **Marks are not thick enough** to confirm the recent min_conviction knob change improved market excess; do not auto-apply further decision-review knob proposals from this payload.
sections.signal_backtest_findings:
- **Backtest (run_count=8, horizon_days=7):** All major signals show positive excess vs benchmark (−1.02%): buy +3.02% (n=232), hold +2.55% (n=715), avoid +2.19% (n=209), strong_buy +1.73% (n=84). Rank order is buy > hold > avoid > strong_buy — strong_buy does not lead at this horizon. insufficient_data is negative (−1.75%, n=3).
- **Historical analysis (run_count=8, window 2026-08-02→2026-08-16, observation_weeks=2 for most buckets):** Smoothed 7-day excess: overlay:buy +3.33% (n=236), overlay:hold +2.74% (n=720), overlay:avoid +2.85% (n=209), overlay:strong_buy +1.65% (n=75). Overlay vs screen at 7d: screen_excess +2.68%, overlay_excess +2.73% (smoothed +2.88% vs +2.91%) — overlay adds negligible lift; downgrade_count=0.
- **Offline simulation (8 periods):** research_overlay total_return −8.97%, benchmark −1.09%, excess −7.88%, 37 trades, £120.55 costs. momentum_grace sim excess −0.34% (19 trades, £30.85 costs). static_levels and trailing_levels match benchmark excess +1.09% with zero trades. comparison_note: “Research overlay produced identical returns to screen-only over this window.”
- **History depth:** run_count=8 across backtest, simulation, and historical_analysis — history is seeded beyond the “run_count < 2” threshold; however historical observation_weeks=2 limits confidence in smoothed estimates.
sections.paper_track_comparison:
- **ai_judgment (primary):** portfolio £901.10 (−9.89% total return); excess_after_costs −11.14%; 21 lifetime trades; cost_drag 16.13%; 3 positions, 0% cash; max_sector_weight 34.79% Industrials. Decision review applied min_conviction 0.15→0.2 for “High cost drag (16.1%)”; new epoch started 2026-08-14 with 0 epoch marks/trades. Last run: 4 trades. Exit_shadow: 8 open, 0 closed — no grace vs rotation outcomes yet.
- **rules (control):** portfolio £826.27 (−17.37%); excess_after_costs −19.73%; 39 lifetime trades; cost_drag 22.83% — highest churn and worst after-cost excess. No knob changes applied. Last run: 4 trades; 16 trades in last 7d matching ai_judgment churn intensity. Exit_shadow: 8 open, 0 closed.
- **momentum_grace (experimental exit overlay):** portfolio £970.87 (−2.91%); excess_after_costs −2.01% — shallowest drawdown and lowest costs (5 trades, cost_drag 2.91%); 5 positions, sector_cap 0.3, max_sector_weight 20% Agriculture/Commodities. Last run: 0 trades; 0 trades last 7d — effectively idle on churn. Exit_shadow: 0 open, 0 closed — no shadow cohort yet.
- **Relative ranking (after-cost excess):** momentum_grace (−2.01%) > ai_judgment (−11.14%) > rules (−19.73%). AI-judgment beats control on excess and cost efficiency but none beat the market.
- **Unrealized vs realized:** JSON provides portfolio_value and total_return (mark-to-market style) but does not separate unrealized vs realized P&L components — comparison uses total_return and excess_after_costs only.
- **Exit_shadow:** Observe-only; all tracks note “Only 0 closed exit(s) so far; wait for a thicker cohort” — knob auto-tune for momentum grace is explicitly deferred.
sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [paper_knobs] Counterfactual min_conviction sweep on ai_judgment (0.15 / 0.20 / 0.25) with full archived weekly-screen replay — expected learning value: quantify whether the applied 0.2 floor closes the gap between replay-estimated cost_drag (−8.72 pp) and realized market excess, given replay currently covers max_positions/sector_cap only.

2. [paper_churn] Hold-buffer and reentry-cooldown A/B on rules vs ai_judgment — both tracks logged 16 trades/7d with 8 full exits and shared reentry_cooldown on AEP.L/SN.L — expected learning value: isolate whether identical churn guards produce divergent cost_drag (22.8% vs 16.1%) due to AI gate selectivity vs rules conviction floor.

3. [offline_sim] Re-run 8-period simulation with research_overlay disabled vs momentum_grace-only vs static_levels baseline — expected learning value: test whether sim’s research_overlay underperformance (−7.88% excess, identical to screen-only) is an overlay artefact or shared with paper ai_judgment path.

4. [analysis] Strong_buy inversion diagnostic at 7d horizon — backtest strong_buy excess +1.73% ranks below buy/hold/avoid; historical smoothed strong_buy +1.65% vs buy +3.33% — expected learning value: determine if conviction tiering or sample composition (n=84 vs 232) explains weak top-bucket performance before any scoring change.

5. [monitoring] Exit-shadow closure watch with weekly rollup template — expected learning value: once rules/ai_judgment open_count=8 begin closing, capture grace_vs_rotation closed counts and by_exit_kind splits to inform deferred momentum_grace knob experiments; trigger when closed_count ≥ 5 per track.
